crossRefs.note: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

translations.web: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.
translations.bsb: You must have a place outside the camp to go and relieve yourself.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:
translations.asv: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:
